title: Source
description: A published or recorded work that records cite: a book, chapter, journal article, thesis, website, talk, recording, video, interview, or an unpublished manuscript or draft. Conversations about the archive itself, such as GitHub issues, are not sources. name.en is its title. The site builds a BibTeX entry for every source.

contributing.description: A database or website that many records draw on, such as Odissi Music. Records name it without its authors; its own page credits them.

in.description: Book, journal or series the source sits in.

archive_url.description: Copy of url in the Internet Archive Wayback Machine.

people.description: Full names, or person ids such as oa-person-000001 for people with a record here.
